profile.title: A people-focused approach to HR.
profile.intro: I am a Psychology graduate with experience in recruitment, organizational development, training and employee administration.
profile.body: My work includes training needs analysis, performance evaluation, career development planning and employee follow-up, alongside initiatives that support integration, workplace culture and well-being.

expertise.title: Areas of expertise
expertise.intro: Three connected areas of human resources practice.

talentAcquisition.title: Talent Acquisition
talentAcquisition.description: Recruitment and selection for corporate, administrative and operational roles, including high-volume hiring, candidate screening, interviews and psychometric assessment.

organizationalDevelopment.title: Organizational Development
organizationalDevelopment.description: Training needs analysis, performance evaluation, career development planning and initiatives that support workplace culture, integration and employee well-being.

hrOperations.title: HR Operations
hrOperations.description: Employee records, onboarding and offboarding, probationary contract follow-up, attendance tracking and payroll support.

experience.title: Experience, in practice.
experience.intro: Recruitment, development and the everyday work of supporting people.

carters.summary: Coordinate recruitment, employee documentation and integration activities across corporate, administrative and operational roles.

responsibilities.recruitment: Manage recruitment and selection for corporate and administrative positions, alongside high-volume hiring for operational roles in the nearshoring segment.
responsibilities.records: Maintain physical and digital employee files and employment documentation.
responsibilities.contracts: Track probationary contracts, review dates and employee evaluation follow-up.
responsibilities.onboarding: Coordinate induction and onboarding activities for new employees.
responsibilities.culture: Organize employee celebrations and commemorative events that support integration and a sense of belonging.
responsibilities.incidents: Record and follow up on employee-related incidents for HR administration.

kaptan.summary: Combine recruitment and training activities with employee follow-up and day-to-day HR administration.

responsibilities.recruitment: Manage vacancy posting, CV screening, interviews and psychometric assessments.
responsibilities.training: Design and implement training programmes based on training needs analysis (DNC).
responsibilities.onboarding: Manage onboarding and offboarding processes and follow up on employee integration and performance.
responsibilities.records: Maintain physical and digital employee records and databases in Buk.
responsibilities.administration: Support payroll processes, attendance tracking and administrative documentation.
responsibilities.workshops: Organize internal workshops on burnout prevention and assertive communication.

colmena.summary: Work across recruitment, organizational development and employee development processes.

responsibilities.recruitment: Lead recruitment processes and organizational development initiatives.
responsibilities.performance: Design and implement performance evaluation processes and career development plans.
responsibilities.followUp: Follow up on employee integration, performance and retention.
responsibilities.culture: Contribute to initiatives that strengthen organizational culture and workplace climate.
responsibilities.training: Support internal training and development programmes.

iztacala.summary: Apply Psychology training in selection processes, teamwork initiatives and workplace well-being activities.

responsibilities.assessment: Participate in the administration and interpretation of psychometric assessments for personnel selection.
responsibilities.wellbeing: Collaborate on strategies for teamwork, emotional resilience and employee well-being.
responsibilities.workshops: Assist with emotional support workshops during the COVID-19 contingency.
